summary: Intermittent rerank latency and score drift when client sends mixed compression-hint headers
description: Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent increases in rerank latency accompanied by subtle score shifts (top-5 order changes) when calling the /v1/rerank endpoint after embedding uploads. Impact: Several API calls that normally return ~120ms p95 are observed at 600-1200ms and sometimes return different top candidates. Environment: Dedicated tenant (NoteStream Labs) running in prod-us-east on dedicated pool rp-dedicated-us-east-3. Observed behavior: problem appears correlated with a particular SDK release that adds a 'compression-hint' HTTP header on embedding uploads. Reranker occasionally falls back to a CPU decode path and triggers a full deserialization + re-normalization which increases latency and causes small numerical differences in similarity scores. This ticket tracks triage, investigation, and remediation for that interaction.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use NoteStream Labs SDK v3.7.2 to upload embeddings with header 'X-Embed-Compression: zstd;hint=compact'
2) Immediately call /v1/rerank against freshly uploaded namespace with same request payload used previously
3) Repeat at ~200 qps for 3 minutes and observe 1-3% of requests with 500-1000ms latency and slight topk reordering
4) Repeat same workload with SDK v3.6.9 (no compression-hint header) and observe stable latency ~120ms and consistent topk order

investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: compression header triggers an alternate decode path not exercised in integration tests.
Reproduced locally by instrumenting reranker to log decode reason; observed 'unknown-compression-hint' branch taking CPU-based decoder and float64->fp16 roundtrip.
Correlated with new SDK that emits 'hint=compact' token; internal decoder expected 'format=compact-v1' -> mismatch leads to safe fallback.
Fallback path includes an extra normalization pass using a slightly different epsilon which explains small score shifts in topk ordering.
Cache TTL: entries uploaded with unknown hint are not matched by the optimized compact-store key due to header-normalization mismatch causing cache misses and additional decode work.
Repro rate ~1-3% at 200 qps; higher p50/p95 when fallback occurs due to CPU decode and KV store hot path.
Linked telemetry: spike in decode_cpu_seconds and embed_cache_miss_rate in tenant namespace around incidents.

resolution: Root cause: embedding ingest/consumer mismatch on a new optional 'compression-hint' header introduced by SDK v3.7.2. Reranker fell back to a CPU decode path and different normalization epsilon for unknown hints, causing increased latency and minor numerical topk variance. Fix: hotfix to normalize compression-hint parsing and treat unknown hints as compatible with the compact path when format signature matches; added telemetry for fallback occurrences. Deployment: canary 10% -> full rollout to dedicated pool rp-dedicated-us-east-3. Post-deploy verification for 48h. Follow-up tasks: add strict schema validation in API gateway, add ingestion compatibility tests for optional headers, and update SDK docs to advertise header format.
